alternatives.description: Leave algebra applicability and non-law boundaries as prose/frontier only.
alternatives.projected_effect: No machine check prevents future evolution code from naming unregistered operators or assuming undeclared algebra laws.
alternatives.risk: Decorative or mathematically invalid algebra claims can enter repository conformance records without deterministic rejection.

alternatives.description: Bind the real evolution path to a source-root-bound six-algebra profile and validate only actually used operators while preserving explicit FRONTIER/NOT_APPLICABLE states.
alternatives.projected_effect: Process and Conformance use become machine-checkable; Policy, Decision and Evidence stay visible frontier; Bridge remains conditional unless actually invoked.
alternatives.risk: The bounded profile deliberately leaves unresolved Level-3 signatures as FRONTIER and therefore does not prove full algebra or GSL compliance.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING cannot reject undeclared law/operator claims or distinguish required FRONTIER from conditional NOT_APPLICABLE algebra modules.
The candidate adds profile/validator maintenance and still requires later Policy/Decision/Evidence executable bindings plus AAP and durable audit closure.

assumptions: Garden v15.5 and its five-file source root remain immutable.
REG-ALGEBRA-001 is the canonical registry owner; this repository profile may bind but may not invent omitted laws.
ActionGate remains the sole admission owner and algebra validation cannot mint authority.
A module is marked APPLIED only when the current pipeline actually invokes semantics supported by an explicit canonical operator set.
reason.uncertainty: The bounded source available to this implementation does not reproduce exact Level-3 executable Decision or Evidence operator signatures; those remain FRONTIER rather than guessed. Policy is also FRONTIER until a concrete Policy Algebra operation is executed by the production path.
counterexamples: A Process receipt claiming universal commutativity must be rejected.
A required algebra cannot be marked NOT_APPLICABLE simply to improve coverage.
A Decision/Evidence algebra marked APPLIED without registered executable operators must be rejected.
A Bridge activation based merely on JSON serialization or Python objects must not be inferred.
An algebra receipt that supplies authority or gate disposition must be rejected.
reason.conclusion: Implement the bounded algebra binding and admit it only if deterministic tests, reasoning/algebra conformance audits, FunctionContract coverage, and the existing trusted production ActionGate all pass without authority expansion or canonical mutation.

obligations.statement: The validator rejects operators and algebra laws not registered by the bounded canonical profile.
Required algebra modules cannot be hidden as NOT_APPLICABLE and FRONTIER never counts as semantic compliance.
Each material governed change carries one action-bound algebra usage receipt validated against current DesignEpoch/source root.
Algebra validation does not mint authority and the trusted WP-007/WP-008 ActionGate remains the admission owner.

items.claim_scope: Requires Process, Policy, Decision, Conformance, Evidence and Bridge algebra conformance without undeclared laws.
Canonical source requires concrete AlgebraSignature instances and says omitted laws are not assumed.
Supplies the bounded operator/non-law semantics used to construct this profile.
WP-009D predecessor with typed Compare/Reason/Proof/Evidence separation.
Latest public zero-cost review supplied no admissible model finding and is not proof or authorization.
